text_en: You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square, and it shall be three cubits high.
text_cn: 应用皂荚木做一祭坛：长五肘，宽五肘，祭坛为方形，高三肘。

text_en: You shall make horns for it on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with bronze.
text_cn: 在祭坛四角上做四翘角，四翘角应由祭坛突出，祭坛要包上铜。

text_en: You shall make pots for it to receive its ashes, and shovels and basins and forks and firepans; you shall make all its utensils of bronze.
text_cn: 再做收灰的盆、铲、盘、肉叉和火盆：这一切用具都应是铜做的。

text_en: You shall also make for it a grating, a network of bronze; and on the net you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.
text_cn: 为祭坛要做一架铜格子，好像网的制法，在网的四角上安上四个铜环，

text_en: You shall set it under the ledge of the altar so that the net shall extend halfway down the altar.
text_cn: 将网安在坛下方的围腰下，直到祭坛半腰。

text_en: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze;
text_cn: 再为祭坛做两根杠杆，杠杆是皂荚木的，包上铜。

text_en: the poles shall be put through the rings, so that the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.
text_cn: 杠杆应穿在环子内；抬祭坛时，杠杆常在祭坛两边。

text_en: You shall make it hollow, with boards. They shall be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
text_cn: 祭坛应用木板做成，中心是空的。在山上怎样指示了给你，就怎样去做。

text_en: You shall make the court of the tabernacle. On the south side the court shall have hangings of fine twisted linen one hundred cubits long for that side;
text_cn: 应做帐棚的庭院： 为向阳的一面，即南面，用捻的细麻做庭院的帷幔；这一面长一百肘。

text_en: its twenty pillars and their twenty bases shall be of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.
text_cn: 柱子二十根，铜卯（mǎo）座二十个，柱钩和横棍是银的。

text_en: Likewise for its length on the north side there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, their pillars twenty and their bases twenty, of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.
text_cn: 为北面也是一样：帷幔长一百肘，柱子二十根，铜卯（mǎo）座二十个，柱钩和横棍是银的。

text_en: For the width of the court on the west side there shall be fifty cubits of hangings, with ten pillars and ten bases.
text_cn: 庭院的西面，帷幔宽五十肘，柱子十根，卯(mǎo)座十个。

text_en: The width of the court on the front to the east shall be fifty cubits.
text_cn: 庭院的前面即东面，宽五十肘；

text_en: There shall be fifteen cubits of hangings on the one side, with three pillars and three bases.
text_cn: 这一边帷幔十五肘，柱子三根，卯（mǎo）座三个；

text_en: There shall be fifteen cubits of hangings on the other side, with three pillars and three bases.
text_cn: 另一边帷幔也十五肘，柱子三根，卯（mǎo）座三个。

text_en: For the gate of the court there shall be a screen twenty cubits long, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen, embroidered with needlework; it shall have four pillars and with them four bases.
text_cn: 庭院的大门：门帘宽二十肘，是用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻织成的：柱子四根，卯（mǎo）座四个。

text_en: All the pillars around the court shall be banded with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their bases of bronze.
text_cn: 庭院所有的柱子，周围用银横棍连贯起来；所有的钩子是银的，卯（mǎo)座是铜的。

text_en: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, the width fifty, and the height five cubits, with hangings of fine twisted linen and bases of bronze.
text_cn: 庭院长一百肘，宽五十肘，高五肘；帷幔是细麻捻的，卯(mǎo)座是铜的。

text_en: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court, shall be of bronze.
text_cn: 帐棚内凡为敬礼用的一切器物，帐棚和庭院的一切橛子，都是铜的。

text_en: You shall further command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of beaten olives for the light, so that a lamp may be set up to burn regularly.
text_cn: 你应吩咐以色列子民，叫他们把榨得的橄榄清油给你送来，为点灯用，好使灯时常点着。

text_en: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening to morning before the Lord . It shall be a perpetual ordinance to be observed throughout their generations by the Israelites.
text_cn: 在会幕内，在约柜前的帐幔外，亚郎和他的子孙应使这灯，由晚上到早晨，常在上主前点燃：这是以色列子民世世代代当守的常例。
